app.name: FarmFair
app.tagline: Know the real price. Sell at a fair price.

hero.title: Know the real price. Sell at a fair price.
hero.subtitle: FarmFair shows you today's mandi rates for your crops, lets buyers bid openly, and holds the money safely until your crop is picked up.
hero.trust: Free to join · No commission from farmers · Works on WhatsApp

problem.title: Why farmers lose money
problem.subtitle: The crop is good. The price is not.

price.title: No idea what the real rate is
price.body: By the time you reach the mandi, you have already accepted whatever the trader says. Official rates are published daily, but almost nobody sees them.

middlemen.title: Too many hands in between
middlemen.body: Every extra agent takes a cut. The farmer carries the risk and keeps the smallest share.

trust.title: Payment after "next week"
trust.body: Crop is collected on a promise. Following up on payment costs time you do not have.

reach.title: Only the buyers you already know
reach.body: A better price may exist two districts away, and there is no way to find it.

one.title: Check the real price
one.body: See today's government mandi rates for your crop, in your district, in Tamil or English.

two.title: List your crop
two.body: Quantity, grade, when it is ready, and the price you want. Add a photo from your phone.

three.title: Compare offers
three.body: Verified buyers bid. Every offer is labelled against the market rate, so you can see what is fair.

four.title: Get paid safely
four.body: The buyer pays into escrow before pickup. The money is released to you once the weight is confirmed.

prices.title: Daily mandi prices
prices.body: Official rates from data.gov.in across Tamil Nadu markets, updated every morning.

fairness.title: Fair price checker
fairness.body: Type any price and see instantly how it compares with today's market average.

escrow.title: Escrow payments
escrow.body: Money is held safely until pickup is confirmed by both sides.

whatsapp.title: Works on WhatsApp
whatsapp.body: Check prices, list a crop and accept an offer by sending a simple message.

tamil.title: Full Tamil support
tamil.body: Every screen, message and alert in Tamil or English, your choice.

ratings.title: Ratings both ways
ratings.body: Farmers rate buyers and buyers rate farmers, so reliable people are easy to find.

cta.title: Start with today's price
cta.subtitle: Signing up takes two minutes and costs nothing.

footer.tagline: Fair prices and safe payments for Tamil Nadu farmers.
